abstract: Uplink power control (ULPC) plays an important role in LTE system. In this paper, a new ULPC approach based on Biogeography-based Optimization (BBO) is proposed. Only with broadcast parameters such as a and P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>, through the BBO Optimization, the cells will be divided into many layers automatically, different compensation offset values allocated at the same time. With the constraint operator of BBO, the throughput of cell-edge UEs can be controlled. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the average throughput and keep a reasonable throughput of UEs at the cell-edge. Besides, this algorithm is efficient without producing additional processing load at eNodeBs, which is practical in real network deployment.

articleTitle: Application of VxWorks interrupt affinity based on MPIC
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With more and more interrupts of integrated core processor(ICP) in avionics, VxWorks interrupt affinity which is applied to ICP has drawn substantial attention. On the multi-core programmable interrupt controller(MPIC) which is hardware platform of ICP, VxWorks interrupt affinity not only helps dispatch interrupt to specific processor core in multi-core processors but also balance the interrupt loading of multi-core processors<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>. In this paper VxWorks affinity is applied to MPIC to achieve the purpose of shortening the interrupt response time. Firstly, the model of MPIC and its working principle have been studied in detail. And then, further research on the implement of VxWorks interrupt affinity based on the MPIC is made. Finally, a new interrupt dynamic routing method using VxWorks interrupt affinity is proposed to enhance the performance of MPIC. The experimental results demonstrate that the method is effective in dispatching the coming intrerrupts across multi-core and response to interrupt more quickly.

articleTitle: An improved OFDM channel estimation technique based on DDST with ICI mitigation over fast fading channel
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For Orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) communication systems, the Doppler frequency offset due to the high speed movement destroys the orthogonality of subcarriers, resulting in the intercarrier interference (ICI), which will degrade the performance of the system. As a result, it is necessary to estimate the accurate channel to equalize the received symbols. On the other hand, the conventional pilot-assisted channel estimation scheme consumes valuable bandwidth. In this paper, an improved OFDM channel estimation technique with ICI mitigation is proposed, which utilizes data dependent superimposed training (DDST) approach to estimate the time-varying channel which is approximated by a basis expansion model (BEM). Based on this method, a more accurate channel estimation is obtained by modifying the structure of DDST at the transmitter and symbol shift cancellation scheme at the receiver. Furthermore, an iterative algorithm is employed to detect the symbols which are destroyed from DDST. The theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the mean square error (MSE) and the bit error rate (BER) performances are improved significantly in high-speed mobility conditions (more than 150 km/h) or high SNR (25 dB) compared to conventional DDST OFDM systems.

articleTitle: Sequential digital multi-signature scheme based on NTRU
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The current multi-signature schemes are generally based on RSA or ECC algorithm, they often have shortcomings of the large amount of calculation, signing process is complex etc. This paper introduced the related concepts and theories of NTRU lattice, proposed a novel sequential multi-signature scheme based on the NTRUSign signature algorithm and analyzed the essential security. The scheme has the following properties: It is mainly based on polynomial multiplication and integer coefficient modular arithmetic and needn't introduce exponential operation; The computation complicacy of the partial signature algorithm and the verification algorithm is independent of the signer's number; The scheme has forward security and prevent fraud of the members effectively.

articleTitle: PASCMP: A novel cache framework for data mining application
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In Chip Multiprocessors (CMP) architecture, traditional shared last level cache (LLC) is widely used. Shared LLC has a large aggregate cache capacity, so it able to minimizes off-chip memory requests. However, with the number of cores increasing, the global wire delay affects cache performance greatly. Data mining is the main method of processing data and knowledge discovery. By analyzing the characterizations of some data mining programs, we find out that the proportion of shared data are relatively less, and a significant portion of accesses are related to private data. Shared LLC does not fit data mining applications,because private data may be placed in a LLC bank that far away from the core which requests the data. In order to adapt to this kind of programs, our new architecture PASCMP makes a trade-off between capacity and wire delay. We design placement and migration strategies to respectively put private data and shared data in the right place at a minimum cost. Thus each core in PASCMP can access its private data nearby, which further reduce the average access latency. PASCMP has better performances than traditional shared LLC CMP on running data mining applications.

articleTitle: Modelling of mixed hub-and-spoke express freight network considering customer satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Considering customer satisfaction, the mixed hub-and-spoke express freight network (MHSEFN) optimization model was established with the minimum cost. The genetic algorithm was designed for solving transportation routes problem and selecting transportation modes, and the tabu search algorithm for facilities location. Empirical analysis showed the optimization programs for designing MHSEFN could be obtained by the model. Based on the model, adjusting the mode of transportation by lowest customer satisfaction could not only take the same good customer satisfaction, but also reduce transportation costs, which reflected the effectiveness of applying the customer satisfaction and MHSEFN for express freight system. It was more comprehensive and closer to reality, could provide theoretical reference for express enterprise's decision-making.

articleTitle: Iterative decision-directed channel estimation for MIMO-OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, an iterative decision-directed channel estimation algorithm is proposed for multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) system. The algorithm is divided into two parts: channel prediction and channel estimation. The basic idea of the channel prediction is to use the auto-regression model and a priori information of the channel to predict channel state. Then channel state is estimated by using the channel prediction information and received signal. The simulation results show that the proposed method can increase the accuracy of the channel estimation and improve the performance of the MIMO-OFDM system. The BER of the iterative DD-CE method has almost 10% promotion when the SNR is 30 and almost 2dB improvement of estimation accuracy than traditional DDCE method.

articleTitle: A dual-polarization reflectarray based on dielectric-metal composite construction working at Ku band
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A novel reflectarray construction composited with dielectric and metal is demonstrated as a possible low-loss and low-cost solution for a dual-polarization antenna. This construction is working based on optical principle, where the phase shift is realized by varying the height of the dielectric-metal slab. And then, a conical-horn antenna is utilized as the primary feed. With the proposed unit-cell construction, a reflectarray composed of 16*16 elements is designed and simulated, which could achieve a 1.5-dB gain bandwidth of 20.38% and a cross-polarized degree below -25dB. The results illustrate that the proposed dual polarization antenna is well suited for communication systems working at Ku-band.

articleTitle: Design and realization of inference engine of fault diagnosis expert system for electronic recycling equipment of missile based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To address the problems of “bottleneck” of expert system (ES) in acquiring knowledge as well as “match conflict” and “combinational explosion” in expert system inference, base on fundamental principles of Maintainability appraisal of electronic recycling equipment in a type of missile, the diagnostic method is proposed for locating the fault of module unit or key component in various PCB Maintainability appraisal models by embedding SVM into ES inference engine, by which the design incorporates construction of ES inference engine diagnosing the faults with electronic recycling equipment in a type of missile based on SVM, together with the method for realization of SVM inference engine. The experiments prove that this method effectively improves ES fault diagnosis rate and identification ratio.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of non-binary RA and QC-LDPC codes
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Repeat Accumulate (RA) codes are subclass of low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes with fast encoder structures. QC-LDPC codes are also a class of LDPC codes and easy to be implemented. There were some paper had researched that non-binary LDPC codes have better performance cover binary ones. In this paper, It constructed non-binary RA codes with linear encoding method and non-binary QC-LDPC codes with algebraic constructions method. The BER performance of RA and QC-LDPC codes over GF(q) were compared by simulation over the Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) channels. The simulation results concluded when code length and code rate are same, the BER performance of this two non-binary LDPC codes are very close, but they still have a little different point.

articleTitle: An adaptive scheme of Systematic Random Network Coding on interfered satellite link
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Systematic Network Coding (SNC) has been studied recent years and it got perfect effect on stable satellite link. However, its performance on interfered satellite link is unsatisfactory according to our research. This paper firstly proposes a novel architecture solution named K-SNC on Link Layer (LL) to improve the goodput of the communication on interfered link. In K-SNC, a Variant of Kalman Filter (VKF) is designed to estimate Packet Erase Rate (PER) in real time and a method is introduced to adjust Encoding Window (ECW) adaptively. A mathematical model is developed as the foundation of VKF about PER changing trend with time lapsing. The relationship is analyzed between the appropriate size of ECW in SNC and the PER on satellite link. Simulation works are implemented with NS-2. In comparison with SNC, K-SNC gets impressive improvement on stable satellite link and provides up to more than 30% higher goodput on the satellite link suffering unpredictable interference.

articleTitle: The subsequent transmission system of collaborative receiving terminal that based on fountain codes
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Since the sixth information revolution, people have entered the era of multimedia information. The transmission of information is no longer in a single way, people's demand for information exchange is more diversified, and the transmission of information environment is also more changeable. Then the collaborative receiving terminal based on fountain codes algorithm can meet all kinds of complex conditions in the current environment to achieve the transmitting and receiving of multimedia. The main work of this paper is a series of analysis and design of the subsequent transmission system of this terminal and to achieve the ultimate function by using the transfer mode that support TCP and UDP protocol.

articleTitle: Management of road lights system using vehicular ad-hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: An enormous amount of electricity is ingested in illuminating the roads and streets of many countries and states in order to avoid the Accidents and Crimes respectively. Although, Vehicles moving through these portions of roads and streets are low in rate and moves from these roads and streets over a specific time period. These parts of roads and streets are not every time engaged with vehicles. In this paper a methodology is suggested that instinctively turns off the lights for that portion of the roads and streets in which vehicles are not moving and switch on the illuminations once of that portion of roads and streets in which movement of vehicles are going to come. Rationally this method will preserve an enormous amount of electricity as well as the life of the lights. After using such method, the proposed system will instinctively supervise, control and detects the lights of roads and streets as there is viability to notice or sense the existence of vehicles, their positioning, their velocities and their directions.

articleTitle: ELM-based speckle reduction for medical ultrasound image
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Reducing the speckle noise in ultrasound images plays an important role in image post-processing, e.g. image segmentation, edge detection and image registration. In this paper, a novel filtering method based on extreme learning machine (ELM) is proposed for ultrasound image denoising. We aim at generating a denoising model learned from the input samples. In the training step, pixel features from the noisy image and the target values from the original image are fed to ELM to learn a speckle reduction model. In the testing step, we obtain the denoising image via the learned model. A pilot study is performed to compare the proposed algorithm with other classical denoising methods using brain tumor ultrasound images. The experimental results show that our proposed method outperforms other methods in reducing speckle noise, and is effective to preserve image details.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of LTE system with different transmission time interval
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Long Term Evolution (LTE) system is the major milestone in stepping towards 4G evolution. Further evolution which is named 4.5G (also called as LTE-Advanced Pro) targeting for lower latency and other enhancements is on the way. Many companies put forward that shortening transmission time interval (TTI) length is a possible way to decrease latency in the system in 3GPP meetings. It is known that by shortening the TTI length, throughput gain can be expected. However, how much gain can LTE system obtain is unknown. Moreover, whether there is negative is ambiguous when TTI length is too small. This paper intends to introduce the performance brought by different TTI length in LTE system. The performance is displayed by comparing with legacy TTI length. It presents in different criterions with figures and data, including advantages and disadvantages. This paper also explain why shortening TTI length can affect LTE system's performance.

articleTitle: A multi-layer VLC system with low-complexity detection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we consider a multi-layer visible light communication system where data of different attribute are split into multiple layers with different bit rates and reliability to satisfy data transmission in priorities. In proposed approach, high-priority data is assigned to upper layers with higher reliability through high diversity, while low-priority data is assigned to lower layers with higher bit rates through high multiplexing. In addition, two detection algorithms are presented for fast decoding: one is low-complexity sum detection, the other is fast maximum likelihood detection. Simulation shows that maximum likelihood (ML) detection has more excellent performance and higher computation complexity than sum detection in general, while both algorithms have similar performance when upper layers obtain sufficient power.

articleTitle: Design of Beidou navigation terminal based on hybrid PCM main memory
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Power, performance, and durability are the most concerned features in design of embedded systems, such as navigation terminals. The storage system is often the main cause of power bottlenecks and durability bottlenecks. In this paper, Phase-Change-Memory (PCM), which has many advantages such as non-volatile, energy saving, robust and so on, is used in the Beidou navigation terminals. With the design of the hybrid memory mode and optimization of storage solutions making use of different storage characteristics, this system reduces the power consumption of the terminal.

articleTitle: Trusted component model and supporting framework based on adaptive mechanism
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: According to the demand of credibility for the application software in the dynamic environment, the component technology is introduced into the development of the trusted service software to improve the software quality and development efficiency. Firstly, the basic idea to ensure the component credibility is described. Then an adaptive trusted component model is given and described in this paper. And subsequently an adaptive supporting framework is proposed. The framework can ensure the reliable performance of the component, can adjust the structure and behavior of the component depending on the change of runtime context adaptively, and can meet the needs of the upper application. Finally, the adaptive adjustment process of components is given based on the proposed model and framework.

articleTitle: A process of high efficiency and low redundancy in content distribution based on Named Data Networking in VANETs
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the rapid increasing in applications such as digital media, social network, and e-commerce applications, the current dominant function of Internet has changed from end-to-end message delivery to large-scale content distribution. It has always been an important challenge in Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) to apply the content distribution mechanism. In paper [1], a simple inter-vehicle one-hop large-size content distribution mechanism was proposed which applies the emerging Named Data Networking (NDN) concept to vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communications. This method improves the performance of distribution efficiency to a certain extent, but it also generates a large amount of redundant Data while distributing content. This paper proposes two innovative mechanisms which include adaptive switching and piecewise random walk method by redesigning the process of content distribution. Finally simulation results from ndnSIM network simulator show that the redesigned mechanism not only improves the transportation efficiency, but also reduces the redundancy of Data packets.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between content type and user behavior of Internet large scale video service
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Internet video content and user experience has always been regarded as the core competitiveness of the video industry. Law of user behavior in the video content in-depth study of large-scale video service for the development of the Internet video industry is significant. In this paper, the Internet video is divided into 7 types of programs, and for the 9 kinds of user interaction behavior to do the correlation analysis. It is found that in the evening 8 o'clock to 10 PM primetime, TV series video programs have the largest number of sessions. In contrast, musical class video programs have the least number of sessions, but in each interactive behavior of the session, the number of interactive behavior is the most. For interactive behavior, the main user interaction behavior is fast forward and rewind operation. And in different content types, it is different. However other 8 kinds of interaction in a session may be in the same average number.

articleTitle: A reliable vehicle detection-location framework based on homography planar projection
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Considering vehicles in highway as surveillance object, the paper proposes a detection-location framework based on homography planar projection. The proposed work allows vehicle' position, speed value and direction angle in physical scale to be accessed. Different from the traditional detection, our detection part employs background modeling and detector trained by AdaBoost one after another to extract vehicle wheels from the scene. So its results is precise enough. At the same time, the shadow suppression is improved by region analysis on hue, that reduces the shadow's influence on contour extraction so that the adjacent vehicles can be separated well. Another contribution of this paper is that, homography relation between imaging plane and ground is ensured by using some designated symbols in highway, which could be used to compute the real location of the detected vehicle wheel. And some interesting information also can be estimated with this method, such as speed value and direction angle. Finally, some experiments is done with filed image sequences and it shows that the presented method is effective.

articleTitle: A method of vehicle trajectory tracking and prediction based on traffic video
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a system solution is designed to improve the service efficiency of intersection. For the purpose, a method of trajectory prediction for vehicle is put forward, which is based on the basis of realize multi-targets tracking. The characteristics of traffic video, structural of road profile and movement of vehicles have been analyzed. We designed the multi-targets tracking algorithm based on particle filter for traffic video sequence, in order to improve the accuracy and rapidity, the heuristic method for multi-targets data correlation is proposed. Based on the results of tracking, we analyze the rule of movement parameters of vehicle as the path has changed, according to the features of structured road the vehicle running status parameters is simplified, and a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) has trained, which is used for vehicle trajectory prediction. In the end, Analysis the basic reason of traffic conflict and the dynamic model of traffic conflict zone is designed. Experimental results demonstrate that, the method of tracking based on particle filter has good tracking performance in traffic video; the vehicle trajectory can be predicted rapidly in the required time, and traffic conflict zone is produced accurately.

articleTitle: An all-in-one model: Computer simulation of population genetics and evolution under Hardy-Weinburg conditions
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Population genetics studies the genetic basis of evolution in a quantitative manner. The Hardy-Weinberg Principle is one of the simplest and most important principles in population genetics. Physical models are generally applied in laboratory of evolution to simulate the Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium, which are often time consuming and error prone. Here, we presented a computer simulation program to model the genetic equilibrium between allele and genotype frequencies of a single gene under Hardy-Weinberg conditions with various selection pressures against dominant and/or recessive allele. The simulation program is based on the simplified all-in-one mathematical model. Results demonstrated that the accuracy of the all-in-one model was comparable to the ones implemented using three individual equations. The all-in-one model provides a more convenient and efficient way with regard to the computer programming. Our computer simulation program will greatly facilitate the biological education to provide the students hands-on experience to investigate the causes of evolutionary changes. In addition, it may also be extended further to simulate the effects of other factors such as genetic mutation and population migration on evolutionary process.

articleTitle: Research on algorithm of audio level compressor
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A audio compressor is an important part of a audio processing system. The compression algorithm designed in this paper will be applied to audio compressor in the digital audio broadcasting transmitter. In this paper, an effective algorithm for dynamic control of the gain by taking mean square value is proposed, and two different audio signal from two channel processing schemes will be compared to get better one on the impact of compression. Then the algorithm is evaluated by the effect of compression of signal amplitude in the MATLAB simulation, and a scheme selected that signal is firstly dealt with to enhance the effect of the dual channel stereo and then is compressed is more suitable for the two channel audio compression from two schemes.

articleTitle: Price-based power control in heterogeneous: A Stackelberg game approach
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper investigates price-based power control strategy for the uplink transmission of the spectrum-sharing femtocell two-tier networks, in which a central macrocell is underlaid with distributed femtocells. As all operating over the same frequency band, interference between them exists inevitably. Assuming that the macrocell base station (MBS) protects itself by give a punitive price to the interference from femtocell users, a Stackelberg game is formulated. In this strategy, it regards the aggregate interference threshold which the macrocell can tolerant as the allocated resource and femtocell users purchase the resource with a competitive price. After this, a Stackelberg game model of the macrocell and femtocells is built to study the joint utility maximization of it. Then, the existence and uniqueness of Stackelberg equilibriums for the proposed game are analyzed. In the Stackelberg game model, femtocell users compete with each other rationally in a non-cooperative pattern according to the power adjustment algorithm. The simulation examples show that the proposed schemes is effective in the uplink transmission and macrocell protection.

articleTitle: A resource occupation ratio based virtual network balanced mapping algorithm in cloud computing environment
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Diverse services need different resources. It is an important issue to achieve the resources occupied by services evenly distribution in network, i.e., avoiding this situation that some devices are fully or even over loaded, while others are free. To solve this problem, in cloud computing environment, the redundant paths in network and data flow partition technology are exploited. The virtual resource occupied by service is modeled, introducing node stress index and link stress index to evaluate the distribution of service occupied network resource, which is abstracted as a non-linear programming problem. A virtual network balanced mapping algorithm is proposed to evenly distribute occupied network resources and improve resource utilization ratio. At last, through numerical simulation, proposed algorithm is superior to existed work in the terms of sub-path number, accepted service request number, etc.

articleTitle: A Cloud-ICT Convergence Service Architecture SDN/NFV powered
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The core-network suffers from inflexible and expensive equipment. Service chaining is a common but important problem of network management in Gi-LAN. The requirements of business agility drive the service architecture to services flexibility and scalability. To address these challenges, SDN centralized control and the NFV concept of CT reconstruction with IT virtualization technology are used to enable a reform in the mobile core network and the Gi-LAN service field. In this paper, following the technical trend of 5G, we propose the Cloud-ICT Convergence Service Architecture to construct an open and elastic digital information ecosystem. This architecture is a solution that provides flexibility in managing infrastructure and uses virtualization to dynamically orchestrate service chains on demand. The information ecosystem constructed in this architecture can provide the functional convergence of IT&CT services in addition to the traditional cellular network functions.

articleTitle: An implementation method of partial correlation matched filter in the CDMA receiver
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Comparing to the acquisition methods based on periodic correlation of pseudo-random-noise code, the partial correlation acquisition have the advantages of stronger adaptability of Doppler frequency, faster search speed and more extensive applications. Matched filter is a kind of linear filter which can maximize the signal-noise-ratio output and has been widely used in optimum receiver of digital communication systems. The acquisition method based on partial correlation matched filter has been presented in this thesis. Furthermore, a detailed description of the design and optimization issues using a field programmable gate array (FPGA) are presented, which would be valuable for the engineering development of high performance receiver. The method can meet the needs of fast synchronization, high sensitivity and high dynamic.

articleTitle: Improved timing recovery loop in laser communication
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Timing recovery is one of the key technologies of space laser communication and measurement. Its accuracy directly affects the performance of the whole system. Timing recovery loop based on Gardner timing error detect algorithm is easy to be interfered by timing jitter. This paper proposes an improved timing recovery loop. Simulation results show that the improved timing recovery loop can effectively reduce the timing jitter to improve the tracking precision and have faster acquisition establish time.

articleTitle: Analysis and research of GNSS near ground signal based on the dilution of precision
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The GNSS signal which is reflected by the surface of the object carries the physical characteristic information of reflecting surface. GNSS-R is a new kind of remote sensing method to study near ground reflected signal and scattering signal. The dilution of precision, as one of the important means to evaluate the performance of satellite navigation and positioning, can be used to retrieve all kinds of physical characteristic information. This paper presents our investigation of the characteristics of the GNSS reflected signal. Through the experiments under the tree, near the river and on the playground, the dilution of precision of the direct and reflected signals were analyzed and compared. It is found that the dilution of precision of the reflected signal is better than the direct signal under the condition of a sheltered environment, and the more rough the reflection surface, the higher the dilution of precision. Therefore, this provides a reference for GNSS-R inverse physical characteristic information.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of key server data store based on private cloud localization
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the era of big data, the requirement for information security and system reliability has become more and more strict. There are some disadvantages in the application of the existing universal data backup and synchronization scheme to the data storage of the key server (The security problems in data transmission and the synchronization problem in the case of the primary is not connected to the secondary). In this paper, according to the traditional multi machine backup technology, a data synchronization scheme is proposed based on the private cloud key server. It effectively solves the problem of data synchronization in the case of the primary and the secondary is not connected. Meanwhile, in the process of data transmission, the method that extends the PKCS#7 international encryption standard is proposed to support domestic encryption algorithm. In this way, it conforms to the State Cryptography Administration standard and improves the security of data transmission.

articleTitle: System Vulnerability Risk Evaluation using Connectivity Operator
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to quantify the risk of security vulnerabilities, a vulnerability risk assessment methodology is proposed based on connectivity Operators, and vulnerability relationship is quantitatively analyzed on the use of the vulnerability attack graph. Two kinds of connectivity operator are proposed to calculate the connectivity between vulnerability, achieving a quantitative analysis of the vulnerability's self risk and spread risk. On this basis the risk assessment algorithm VREA-CO is raised, assessing the system overall risk. The vulnerability assessment results can help managers identify key vulnerabilities, and improve safety management efficiency. Example analysis shows that the method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Belief propagation and self-adaptive voting dense stereo disparity estimation for textureless scene 3D Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: High quality dense disparity map building was an important topic in diverse stereo vision research and applications. In practice, the textureless regions were always existed in both indoor and outdoor environment, and still not be well done for stereo vision system always with some drawbacks areas in dense disparity map. For more widely usability of various lenses, a toilless distortion correction was achieved by combing with a proposed autonomous calibration method and polar constraints. A color similarity probability based belief propagation algorithm (BP) is proposed to solve the depth discontinuous problem of occlusion and obtain an initial dense disparity map with kinds of drawbacks. In accurate disparity estimation step, Mean-Shift algorithm was utilized for initial similar disparity plane segment and a self-adaptive voting disparity plane fitting method was proposed for fitting optimization to adjust the drawbacks in the initial disparity estimation. Experimental results of real images in both indoor and outdoor environments validate the efficiency.

articleTitle: An ant colony algorithm for scheduling instrumentation ship at sea of space launch mission
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the aggravation of space launch missions, the generally manual decision-makings could not have gotten a better solution for handling issues related to offshore instrumentation ship scheduling, and it has caused lots of waste of resources and even formed many constraints on space launch missions. This article departing from the perspective of the relevant maritime instrumentation ship scheduled, describes the actual analysis of its problem and establishes the mathematical model, then with the perspective of intelligent optimization, it uses ant colony algorithm to get fitting solutions. In the case that meets the relevant constraints by experimental examples, we can get closer to a multi-objective scheduling scheme, so that it has a good practical significance for solving practical problems.

articleTitle: The modified simplex method of adjustable coefficient
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A kind of modified simplex method with adjustable coefficient is proposed, as the expansion and compression factors take some fixed values in simplex method. The modified method couples with Armijo criterion that is an inexact line search technology, which takes the expansion and compression factors as step sizes to choose. The expansion and compression factors can be controlled, which overcomes the shortcoming that the two factors are taken as fixed values for different problems.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of a dual-band Frequency Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper presents a new design of a dual-band Frequency Selective Surface based on using different kinds of FSS units nested together, and the impact of its performance for the change of unit size, medium thickness, incidence angle and other factors are summarized in detail. At last, a dual-band FSS operating at 5/19.5GHz respectively is designed, and it has a stable resonant frequency in TE and TM mode.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of spinal MRI image segmentation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Using the method of image visual processing to assist clinical diagnosis is an important technology of medicine field, because of this, gradually become a hot research topic in recent years. Spine MRI image contains important information of spine and plays an active role in diagnosis, therefore, there must be a robust method for the image segmentation and extract the useful information, this is also helpful for the subsequent 3D reconstruction. In this paper, we propose a fully automatic, unsupervised segmentation algorithm of intervertebral disc using an improved marker controlled watershed transformation which combines intention and prior shape information. Experimental results show that our algorithm can accurately extract the outline of intervertebral disc from normal spine and different degree of deformation of the spine. Obviously, this method is robust enough to deal with different shapes of disc.

articleTitle: Design of a deep water cage culture environment monitoring system based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of deep water cage culture digital management technology and accurate cultivation techniques, monitoring the overall deep water cage culture environment has become extremely important. A deep water cage culture environmental monitoring system is proposed for distant deep water cage culture sites to address the inconvenience of manual monitoring and the low realization rate of automated environmental control. The proposed system integrates a ZigBee wireless communication network, an Ethernet-based server monitoring platform, and a mobile client monitoring platform. Information about the cage culture environment is obtained by logging in to the remote server via the mobile client, and the available information includes water temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, and water velocity. This system achieves accurate monitoring of the deep water cage culture environment, and also solves field cabling and low efficiency problems. Additionally, the TCP/IP-based server monitoring platform and the mobile client monitoring platform are fully functional with a friendly user interface, which provides efficient and convenient management for culturists.

articleTitle: The recognition system for zip-top cans in the beverage showcase
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The beverage showcase that is used to store cold drinks is ubiquitous in supermarkets, which have brought great convenience. However, a great disadvantage of the beverage showcase is that it needs manual check of remaining volume. Therefore, a recognition system is proposed in this paper to solve this tricky problem and to make our lives more intelligent. Positions, brands and the number of zip-top cans could be identified easily in the recognition system which monitors the dynamics of beverages in the beverage showcase. After starting the system, the key points detector that matches input picture and feature dataset is first executed. It will recognize zip-top cans that are less partially occluded or not covered. Next, the system carries out the rims detector to detect all upper rims of zip-top cans, which determine positions and the number of cans. In the rims detector, we propose an evaluation algorithm for the qualified ellipse. Then the colors detector detects main color blocks near the upper rims of zip-top cans to determine brands of cans covered each other. Three detectors are combined to constitute a recognition system with high accuracy and practical application value. In the system, the recognition rate is above 85%.

articleTitle: A novel Chinese organization name extraction approach using CCRFs in micro-blog
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the rapid growth of Internet-scale, social media services (such as micro-blog) have gradually become a popular platform for the dissemination of information, which provides new research direction for Named Entity Recognition(NER). However, the informal structure and incorrect grammar in micro-blog and the complexity of Chinese expression make a serious challenge for NER task. Automatic identification of Chinese organization name in many NLP task is a difficult problem. To solve this problem, this paper presents a novel method for Chinese organization name recognition based on cascaded conditional random fields (CCRFs) where the identification task is divided into two subtasks. Firstly, the person name and location name in the micro-blog texts are first recognized by a Conditional random fields (CRFs) model. The result then is passed to another CRFs model and supports the decision of this model for identification of the complicated organization names. The experiment results show that the proposed method delivers better performance than existing methods.

articleTitle: Security outage probability with antenna selection in Full-duplex system
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we study the security performance with antenna selection in full-duplex system, where the destination is equiped with mutil-antennas. In our proposed scheme, the destination can combine a subset of “strongest” paths out of available paths from the source, and the others can sends jamming to the eavesdropper. We obtain the closed form expressions of security outage probability. Combining the half-duplex system, the security performance can be improved. With the selected jamming antennas increasing, the security performance is increasing when the SNR is high.

articleTitle: Visual tracking based on adaptive background modeling and improved particle filter
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a visual tracking algorithm based on adaptive background modeling and improved particle filter was proposed, which can be effectively used to track the players in sports video. Adaptive background modeling was used to extract motion information in the dynamic scene, and obtained precise motion region through a designed target selection filter, then, do the tracking algorithm under particle filter framework. The proposed algorithm solved the problem which needs to manually initialize the target position when tracking algorithm is applied to the engineering project. Besides, traditional resampling algorithm has degeneracy problem which could influence tracking effect when particle set is large, the paper also improved the resampling algorithm with a classified resample method. In the end, experimental results showed that the proposed algorithm has advantages in precision and robustness compared with the traditional particle filter.

articleTitle: Audio fingerprint extraction based on time-frequency domain
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper introduced the development background and analyzed the research significance of audio recognition system. Then explained the principle of digital audio fingerprinting technology and related applications, and introduced the basic concepts and properties. It also analyzed the most commonly used model and summarized the corresponding algorithm of digital audio system. Finally, several methods of extracting feature parameters are analyzed, and the method of feature extraction based on wavelet transform is proposed. In this study, it used wavelet packet technology, the coefficients of each frame of the audio file are decomposed into 3 layers, and then, used the decomposition coefficient energy, zero crossing rate, the center of mass as the audio fingerprint. In addition to the above fingerprint, the design also used the audio parameters MFCC as another audio fingerprint features.

articleTitle: A load balancing method based on dynamic time step feedback
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In dynamic environments, dynamic load balancing plays an important role in improving the performance of large-scale parallel computer systems. It can reduce the response time of the calculations and maximize the resources utilization of system. To improve the parallel efficiency in dynamic systems, a dynamic load balancing method with a prediction and dynamic time step feedback was developed. The feedback is varied dynamically by using a time step and processing capability prediction algorithm combined with a dynamic programming algorithm for task redistribution. Apply this method in ab initio molecular dynamics simulation, this algorithm showed significantly better adaptability and scalability compared to one that employs a static time step feedback.

articleTitle: A prediction-based ACO algorithm to dynamic tasks scheduling in cloud environment
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In recent years, cloud computing has gained more and more attention. Task and resource scheduling becomes one of the key problems in cloud computing. This paper refers to a new prediction-based algorithm based on Ant Colony Optimization which combines the available computing resources (referred as Virtual Machines, VMs) with arriving jobs with various Quality of Service constraints (QoS, defined by users). The traditional Ant Colony Optimization algorithms usually contain properties of computing resources but without taking users' constraints into consideration and ignore the heterogeneity of cloud resources. Therefore, an algorithm in this paper is proposed which classifies the jobs into two species. And then users' QoS constraints are sorted as well as computing resources according to their computing capabilities. This paper aims at proposing an ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm to schedule jobs with various QoS parameters on VMs with different resource parameters. Experiment results show that the proposed prediction-based algorithm outperforms the ACO algorithm to some extent in finding the best dispatch of tasks to VMs.

articleTitle: Tax-control network invoice machine management platform based on socket
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Time and labor consuming, complexity of invoice inspection, as well as difficulty in curbing invoice crimes are emerging challenges in the process of invoicing management which need to be addressed. In this paper, based on the actuality of our Country, a novel tax-control network invoice machine management platform (TNIMMP) is presented, it utilizes the technology of computer and network communication, enables tax authorities collect and administrate taxation details effectively, and assists taxpayers accomplish critical taxation processes without going to the tax bureau. The TNIMMP system reached the goal of remote controlling and administrating the network invoice machines. This paper describes the Client/Server architecture of the TNIMMP system, which based on a cluster of servers. The function design of our TNIMMP system is focused on invoice application and time-limited invoice submit. And a detailed analysis of characteristics of the TNIMMP system was illustrated, compared with current taxation systems, the TNIMMP system can be used to monitor and administrate the invoice, and curb the invoice criminals. And it helps realize “controlling taxation by invoices” to “controlling taxation by information”. And extraordinary attention to the high-reliability and high-performance of our TNIMMP system are given, so as to address the problem of stable operation and high-concurrency access.

articleTitle: Non-orthogonal multiple access with buffer-aided cooperative relaying
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a transmitter-selection based scheme in non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) network with buffer-aid relaying. We apply the buffer-aided tool in the user, which have better network condition, to increase the reliability of the NOMA network. Our proposed scheme selects a transmitter based on the channel quality and the buffer state of the relay. The Markov Chain (MC) model is adopted to analyze the buffer state transition properties. The average packet delay and the outage probability of the system is analyzed. Numerical results show that the NOMA relay system with buffering significantly outperform the system without buffering in the throughput analysis.

articleTitle: K-means clustering algorithm for full duplex communication
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Full duplex communication is a new wireless technology which can at most improve the spectrum efficiency twice. In full duplex system, the UEs receiving data may suffer severe interference from the UEs transmitting signals with same subcarrier. In this paper, a K-means clustering algorithm is stated to lower interference between UEs in different groups and a method of resource allocation is proposed to reduce co-channel interference among neighbor users. Simulation results show that with the proposed algorithm the interference between UEs can be restrained effectively and the spectral efficiency of system has been improved significantly.

articleTitle: An improved harmony search for travelling salesman problem
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Harmony search(HS) is a music-inspired metaheuristic for optimization problem. HS is simple to implement and apply on several kinds of problems. But HS is not successful to solve large size of travelling salesman problem(TSP). In this paper, we try to find the difficulties of HS on TSP. And we propose the elitists harmony search(EHS) to overcome these difficulties. The EHS reorganizes the harmony memory, which is divided into two groups: elitists and explorers. Elitists are used to raise the intensification and explorers are for the diversification. The experimental result shows that EHS is better than HS average 25.49%, and EIHS is better than IHS average 20.09%. The difference of execution time is very small. And for larger TSP benchmark, the EHS is more better than HS.

articleTitle: Invulnerability analysis of vehicular ad hoc networks based on temporal networks
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As network invulnerability can provide the optimization of network topology control, protocol development and network management with new guidance, the invulnerability properties for vehicular ad hoc networks against random attacks and intentional attacks are analyzed in this paper. Based on vehicular mobility simulation with VanetMobiSim, it is firstly shown that the traditional static approach when adopted in VANETs whose topology frequently changed over time overestimates system invulnerability while a temporal approximation captures more accurately the system performance. Then the influences by patterns of attacks, communication range and network density on invulnerability of VANETs are given. The experimental results show that VANETs have a strong invulnerability faced with random attacks while its invulnerability under intentional attacks is fairly low and the temporal invulnerability increases with communication radius getting larger under intentional attack. However, the effect of communication radius on temporal invulnerability for VANETs faced with random attack is uncertain. What is more, node density has a positive impact on invulnerability.

articleTitle: Research of penetration test based on mobile Internet
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: At present, penetration test technology is mostly used in traditional networks. With the rapid development of mobile Internet, the security problem has become more and more serious. This paper puts forward a kind of penetration test method based on mobile Internet. This method builds a test platform with the actual network, and then design an execution plan of penetration test program through the vulnerabilities of mobile Internet. The results show that, the mobile communication terminal is affected most obviously by the web pressure test, and the energy consumption is the biggest.

articleTitle: Effect of caching threshold in content centric network: A simulation-based study
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Threshold-based caching has been widely researched in the literature of content-centric network. Most of the existing approaches only consider the user experience performance, i.e. the average request delay, in the cache networks. In this paper, we propose to consider the system cost metric of cache utilization ratio, and develop a kind of threshold-based caching algorithm that aims to reduce the total missed traffic in network as well as the user performance. Our proposed threshold reflects the effect of local disk size and favors the long-term content popularity. Simulation-based studies show that, there exists an optimal point in the performance space of cache utilization ratio. What's more, given relative small size cache disk resource, the optimal threshold setting can outperform the default CCN caching policy greatly in either user experienced request delay and cache utilization ratio.

articleTitle: Efficient surrogate-based antenna design optimization using novel sampling methods
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Commonly used optimization methods require hundreds or even thousands of evaluations of objective function. Due to the high computational cost of electromagnetic (EM) simulation, the efficiency of directly using these methods is often very low. This paper presents an efficient surrogate-based antenna design optimization method in which the number of simulations is decreased by a novel sampling strategy. The key ideas are: (1) Limited initial sampling points are uniformly distributed in the parameter space by an improved Latin hypercube sampling algorithm. (2) In each optimization loop, a new sampling point chosen from several candidates is used to update the surrogate according to its uniformity and estimated fitness value. The operation and performance of the proposed method are demonstrated using two antenna design examples. Comparing with genetic optimization, the number of EM simulation is reduced by 75% and 79% respectively.

articleTitle: A hybrid scheme for routing lookup with fast updates based on TCAMs
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The exponential growth of routing tables in routers results in the exhaustion of IPv4 address. The urgent demand of high speed of routing lookup makes the Ternary CAM (TCAM), which needs only one cycle in each parallel lookup, a state-in-art hardware for Internet Protocol (IP) lookup and packet forwarding. However, the performance of TCAM is cut down due to too much update time. In this paper, we proposed a hybrid scheme for routing lookup with fast updates based on TCAMs. In our scheme, about 95% prefixes to be updated need no more than one movement. In the worst case, delete a prefix needs only 2 movements and insert a prefix needs 5 movements. The proposed scheme could fit different routing tables.

articleTitle: Adaptive spatial reuse of spectrum resources based on multi-parametric quadratic programming for cognitive radio network
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For cognitive radio network, there are multiple primary and secondary users in a region. Radio spectrum has the distinctive feature that transmissions at neighboring locations on the same channel interfere with each other, whereas the same channel can be used at far-off locations without mutual interference. Thus, spatial reuse provides an opportunity to increase spectrum efficiency and improve quality-of-service (QoS), etc. This paper presents an effective adaptive spatial reuse method of spectrum sources via multi-parametric quadratic programming. The proposed approach can not only minimize the transmitted power but also guarantee that the received signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) is strictly above the prescribed QoS constrained threshold at each secondary user (SU) and the interference power (IP) is strictly below the prescribed threshold at the primary users (PUs). Simulation results are presented to verify the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of two frequency offset acquisition algorithms
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Two typical frequency offset acquisition schemes by measuring the phase difference between two received signals on different samples are proposed in this paper. A new aspect on the problem of how to choose a better method to estimate the frequency offset between two schemes is the key research content. In order to find out how many factors the frequency offset estimation accuracy is determined by, the corresponding comparison through mathematical analysis on signal-to-noise (SNR) ratio is provided. Through mathematical calculation results, it will show how the estimation accuracy is controlled by both the original received signal SNR and its own accumulated frequency offset value. And the result leads to an optimal switching strategy between two schemes that maximize the device's immunity to frequency uncertainties.

articleTitle: Ebola prediction with epidemic model
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To control Ebola epidemic to a maximum extent, the article makes analysis by introducing effects of medicines and vaccines. Based on the basic epidemic model, differential equations of Ebola transmission process are obtained with the refinement and classification of the initial ones due to characteristics of different stages during transmission and infection process. The model is considered well conformed to actual data by fitting with data from WHO. Thus, it manages to predict total epidemic cases in a time period without human intervention.

articleTitle: Comparative study of ESE and IIC for OFDM-IDMA systems
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, interleave-division multiple access (IDMA) combined with orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems is discussed. The elementary signal estimator (ESE) and iterative interference cancellation (IIC) multiuser detection (MUD) are introduced and compared. Both methods have almost the same level of computational complexity, while the bit error rates (BER) performance of the latter is much better than the former. The simulation results show that, for multipath channel, the more channel taps, the better BER performance comparison. For the same system conditions, IIC can serve more users than ESE.

articleTitle: Target tracking based on noise eliminated color histogram
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a new description model which has eliminated the background noise and established a stable tracking system. The proposed method has great robustness to changes in illumination and viewpoint. Simultaneously, the algorithm is applicable to indoor as well as outdoor scenes. In addition, comparative experiments on system performances between the proposed algorithm and the traditional Mean Shift algorithm were conducted and simultaneously results showed that our approach was more effective when the motion target was similar to the background.

articleTitle: Satellite systems
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In mobile satellite network, scarcity of L/S frequency is an critical constraint for global communication. Moreover, the L/S frequency allocated for mobile satellite system (MSS) spans through more than 1GHz bandwidth with lower boundary 1610MHz and upper boundary 2690MHz. It entails several major technical challenges, such as high sampling rate required for wideband sensing, limited power and computing resources for processing load to seek for frequency through implementing wideband spectrum sensing. This paper investigates the issue of frequency availability in MSS, and wideband spectrum compressed signal detection approach is employed to obtain locations of active primary users (PUs) that should be avoided during frequency option. We propose novel discrete cosine transform based wideband spectrum compressed sensing scheme (DCT-WSCS) with significant improvement in detection probability and recovery accuracy compared with conventional discrete Fourier transform based wideband spectrum compressed sensing scheme (DFT-WSCS). Additionally, simulations are performed to demonstrate the performance of the proposed scheme in aspect of signal detection probability, reconstruction precision, and processing time.

articleTitle: Improved method of character traits based on Wechat dataset
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In recent years the communication tool Wechat is used widely, however few attention to the academic research. Moreover, there are very few studies about identifying character traits from its data. Previously a method based on data features to decide character traits was proposed in our paper. Here an improve method of the feature set is given through refining new features, and building the feature subset employing feature extracting algorithm. Then it compares the contributions of the original feature set with the feature subset through several classification algorithms. Experimental results show that the classification based on data features can efficiently identify character traits.

articleTitle: Overlapping particle track separating and measuring method
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The overlapped particle tracks seriously affects the measurement accuracy of the particle track. In order to separate the overlapped particle track, a twice erosion operation was proposed by combining image matching. First, by the area and circularity of particle track as shape feature, no overlapping particle tracks were detected and classified. Then, by using these identified particle tracks as template to form the structural elements, the overlapping particle track image was separated by twice erosion operation. Finally, the classification image are gotten by each particle track's shape. Experimental results show that particle track image can effectively segmented by combined with shape matching and twice erosion operation. And it eliminates the influence of track overlapping to image measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of quantitative data models in network management
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the telecommunication, especially in the wireless telecommunication, the way of data delivery (i.e. protocol) is indispensable for evaluation indicators—energy consumption, traffic delay, and delivery ratio. While, with the supporting of quantitative data model, this paper designs a frame which could manage the reasonable protocols to perform best during the data transmission. The frame what we called Super-hybrid frame utilizes the Queue Length-Aware (QLA) scheme, Probability Decision Process (PDP) scheme and Priority Strategy and Service Differentiation (PSSD) scheme. Therefore, the frame could not only optimize the performance in different scenarios, but also make the reasonable transmission in the network who contains hetero-priority data packets. For persuasive, the frame is simulated with IEEE 802.15.4.

articleTitle: Automated selection of CVs from massive SDSS photometric data
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: We apply Support Vector Machine (SVM) to construct the photometric models for cataclysmic variable stars (CVs) and identify CVs in massive photometric data of Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS). Based on the study of spectral characteristics and the color information, orthogonal criterion combined with SVM is used for modeling the photometric data. We present 10 groups of representative photometric models constrained by SVM, which can be used as features for classification and also for photometric criterion. In the experiment, we develop and demonstrate the automatic selection method for CVs. We have also made hybrid verification through logistic regression and artificial neural network to verify the experiment results. The photometric model improve the identification accuracy of CVs in massive SDSS spectra data. The result shows that the photometric model can improve the classify accuracy on the research of five color feathers in CVs classification tasks.

articleTitle: Autoscaling prediction models for cloud resource provisioning
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The elasticity mechanism of cloud computing can auto scale cloud resources to meet users' need. Elastic adding or removing virtual machines is the most common method to achieve the auto scaling. But the elastic scaling often takes tens of minutes, which is inefficient for the running workload. To reduce the latency and improve the quality of service (QoS), the new virtual machine should be provisioned when the request arrives. In this paper, we present a prediction framework for virtual machines provisioning. This prediction framework includes three main modules: monitor, filter and predictor. This framework aims to predict the upcoming workload and provision the virtual machines in advance. To get the reasonable monitored metrics, we propose the Kalman filter method to preprocess the raw data. Moreover, we present five different prediction models as the based predictor. These prediction models include moving average (MA), auto regression (AR), auto regression integrated moving average (ARIMA), neural networks (NN) and support vector machine (SVM). Meanwhile, we propose four evaluation metrics, including the prediction error, the time saving, under-prediction resource and over-prediction resource, to evaluate the performance of prediction framework. In addition, we use Alicloud as the experimental infrastructure. Experimental results demonstrate that the prediction framework can reduce the latency of provisioning cloud resource and improve the cloud service quality.

articleTitle: A new method to evaluate the readability of head up display
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: By researching about PJND (Perceptible Just Noticeable Difference) theory, this paper established an evaluation method of head up display readability based on PJND, combined with the characteristic of head up display. By simulation, this paper got some disciplinary results that how the chromaticity of background, interferences (specular reflection, diffuse reflection and glare) impacts the readability of head up display. Simulation result shows that, the differences between background chromaticity and object chromaticity bigger, head up display needs a lower luminance contrast; when the environment luminance is constant and the interferences increase, we need a bigger luminance contrast to satisfy the readability; when the environment luminance and luminance contrast are all constant, to satisfy the readability, the maximum of the interference is limited.

Author Keywords: evaluation method of head up display

articleTitle: Optimizing the effects of load-shedding through micro-load management in generation constrained power system
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The continuous increase in electricity demand all over the world is putting huge burden on electricity utility providers to effect various types of load shedding in order to avoid total blackout. Load shedding is implemented mostly by turning off affected communities or areas from the main grid thereby depriving them from electricity supply. This paper attempts to propose a solution to this problem by granularly optimizing load levels of each metering units by turning off specific loads from household or and industrial demands in order to reduce the total effective load on the smart meters thereby reducing the overall effect on the generation as well as the distribution systems. The Design Science Methodology was used in the research. The preliminary results from the study shows that implementing this approach to load shedding will drastically reduce the overall effects of this intervention by utilities on their subscribers.

articleTitle: A novel 2-D DOA estimation method via sparse L-shaped array
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel method for two-dimensional (2-D) direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation employing a sparse L-shaped array is proposed. The array composed of one traditional uniform linear array (ULA), one sparse ULA and an auxiliary sensor. In the proposed method, the elevation angles are estimated by two steps. The first step is to estimate the ambiguous elevation angle by the ESPRIT-like method. The second step is to remove the ambiguity by the proposed disambiguation procedure. Then, the azimuth angles are estimated by the elevation estimates and all the data of the cross-covariance matrix (CCM) without any pairing procedures. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method provides a much better estimation accuracy than the existing methods with comparable computational complexity.

articleTitle: Specific emitter identification based on normalized frequency spectrum
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Specific emitter identification (SEI) refers to the capability to associate a received pulse waveform with a unique emitter. It can be used to identify illegal emitters and detect camouflaging attackers. As communication security become increasingly important and frequency hopping technique is widely used, a SEI method for frequency hopping signals is meaningful. In this paper, a novel SEI method based on normalized frequency spectrum features is proposed. Box-counting fractal dimension is used to extract the transient signal. Principal component analysis is used to extract radio frequency fingerprint by analyzing the transient signals' normalized frequency spectrum. Signals from four mobile phones are collected and a support vector machine classifier is created for classification. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Ciphertext retrieval against insider attacks for cloud storage
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the improvement of awareness of data privacy, the user's sensitive data is usually encrypted before uploading them to the cloud. The searchable public-key encryption with keyword search provides an efficient mechanism to achieve the encrypted data retrieval without the complicated key management of symmetric encryption. Therefore, it is a critical technique on promoting secure and efficient cloud storage. Unfortunately, only one existing construction of ciphertext retrieval scheme is secure against inside keyword guessing attacks (KGA). In this paper, we build a framework to resist insider attacks. Additionally, we propose an efficient ciphertext retrieval with keyword search scheme with a designated tester (dCRKS), which is secure against inside keyword guessing attacks (KGA). Our security proof and performance analysis demonstrate that our scheme is practical for retrieval data stored in the cloud server.

articleTitle: A target tracking algorithm for vision based sea cucumber capture
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For capturing sea cucumber in the sea, an object tracking method based on Mean-Shift algorithm was proposed. Firstly, defogging algorithm was used to get restored image, and the feature of color histogram was extracted from the restored image. Then the local image was cropped at the same position and local area in the second frame. Mean-Shift algorithm was used to search the feature of color histogram in cropped area. Finally, tracking was realized by searching the searching process converged in the next frames one by one. Compared with the color histogram Mean-Shift algorithm (CHMS) algorithm, the proposed algorithm have better tracking performance and robustness.

articleTitle: Probability-based delay scheme for resisting SDN scanning
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Scanning attack is usually the precursory step to attack a network by which adversaries gather significant information of the network and employ it to discover the vulnerabilities and save their precious time. Recently, researchers have proved that adversaries can scan a SDN network utilizing packets response time difference. In this paper, a probability-based delay scheme is introduced to combat this kind of scanning. An unpredictable delay strategy is proposed, which delays packets sent to SDN network within an adjustable probability to achieve moving target defense (MTD). The strategy aims at confusing the time information received by adversaries and reduce the performance cost as much as possible. Furthermore, analytical reasoning and an experiment of our implementation on a programmable SDN environment indicates that this delay strategy can effectively impact the statistical result of a scanning attack, and introduce a little performance penalties for the SDN network.

articleTitle: Soft computing in array pattern peak based on butterfly mating optimization
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The paper focuses on the communication mechanism of butterfly mating optimization. The functions and influence facts of UV update, distribution and local mate selection are analyzed. The pattern of the binary array model of half wave oscillator is also calculated by butterfly mating optimization, and the simulation results also point the peak value of main lobe. Compared with the operation results of glowworm swarm optimization algorithm, the results of butterfly mating optimization algorithm, which is used in the array model, prove its feasibility and correctness.

articleTitle: A new distance detection algorithm for images in deflecting angle
publicationTitle: 2016 2nd IEEE International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of transportation industry, there are increasing numbers of surveillance cameras set up along the road. When taking camera calibration in these cameras, there are always no suitable calibration targets. Moreover, it is impossible for the cameras which have been installed to meet the requirements such as the locations, the directions of movement and so on. Thus, the traditional method of camera calibration cannot be used as usual. This paper puts forward a new distance detection algorithm for images in deflecting angle based on rectangular pattern.
